events.title: In May 2026, how many coffee purchases were for strictly more than 100 THB? A purchase of exactly 100 THB does not count. Answer with the whole number in `value`.

events.result:
{"exit_code":0,"stdout":"Usage: oled transactions list [options]

List transactions with optional filters

Options:
  --account <id>      filter by account id (matches either side)
  --from <date>       filter from date
  --to <date>         filter to date
  --query <text>      filter by search text
  --amount <decimal>  filter by exact amount (decimal)
  --currency <code>   scope rows to that currency's ledger, and the unit
                      --amount is given in; --account names a ledger of its own
                      and wins
  --limit <n>         max rows (default 50, max 500)
  --offset <n>        rows to skip; repeat with offset += returned while the
                      summary says has_more
  --group             fold linked transactions into their group clusters
  --include-void      include mirrors voided by `transactions merge` (hidden by
                      default)
  --no-redact         skip PII redaction (on by default)
  --json              Emit NDJSON (machine-readable) instead of human output
  --no-color          Disable ANSI color output
  --config <path>     Config file to use (default ~/.oled/config.json)
  -h, --help          display help for command
","stderr":""}

{"exit_code":0,"stdout":"Usage: oled report [options]

Income, expenses, and networth

Options:
  --from <date>    start date
  --to <date>      end date
  --json           Emit NDJSON (machine-readable) instead of human output
  --no-color       Disable ANSI color output
  --config <path>  Config file to use (default ~/.oled/config.json)
  -h, --help       display help for command

Behavior: sums income, expenses, and networth over a date range. For net worth use oled status.
Typical flow: both dates are required and ISO (YYYY-MM-DD).
Example: oled report --from 2025-01-01 --to 2025-03-31 --json
","stderr":""}
